Table 5-7.  Checking and Repairing

| Fault                                                | Possible Cause                               | Remedy                                                        |
|------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| Motor will not rotate                                | Disconnected                                 | Repair or change                                              |
| Motor will not rotate                                | Trip thermal circuit break                   | After, analysizing the cause, on                              |
| Motor will not rotate                                | Poor contact of switch                       | Inspect of contacts                                           |
| Motor will not rotate                                | Low voltage                                  | Contact the Electric Power Co.                                |
| Motor will not rotate                                | Faulty motor                                 | Exchange                                                      |
| Motor will not rotate                                | Foreign matters in the fan                   | Disassemble and Repair                                        |
| Motor will not rotate                                | Wet moving part (damaged Liner Ring Bearing) | Disassemble and Repair                                        |
| Motor will not rotate                                | Rusted shaft                                 | Disassemble and Repair                                        |
| Motor rotates but coolant will not pump.             | Low rotation speed                           | Check the rotation system                                     |
| Motor rotates but coolant will not pump.             | Clogged pipe line                            | Check and clean pipe                                          |
| Motor rotates but coolant will not pump.             | Pump improperly flooded in coolant           | Fill coolant and clean tank                                   |
| Motor rotates but coolant will not pump.             | Fan not being flooded in coolant             | Open the air plug one time and allow the ambient air to enter |
| Coolant pumps but can't obtain the specified amount. | Clogged fan and case                         | Disassemble and Repair                                        |
| Coolant pumps but can't obtain the specified amount. | Worn fan                                     | After diassembling, repair or change                          |
| Coolant pumps but can't obtain the specified amount. | Water leakage in discharging pipe            | Check and repair                                              |
| Coolant pumps but can't obtain the specified amount. | Low rpm                                      | Inspect or review the rotation system                         |
| Coolant pumps but can't obtain the specified amount. | Clogged pipe                                 | Check and clean the pipe                                      |
| Overload of motor                                    | High gravity and viscosity                   | Check coolant                                                 |
| Overload of motor                                    | Contacted rotation part                      | Exchange                                                      |
| Overload of motor                                    | Excess discharge                             | Exchange                                                      |
| Overload of motor                                    | Low voltage                                  | Contact Electric Co.                                          |
